title: Core agent's `save_state` and `load_state` methods are currently sync -- consider moving them to async as I/O will be needed.

Yes, this is an agent issue.  
The issue pertains to memory-related behaviors, specifically the `save_state` and `load_state` methods, which are part of the agent's memory mechanisms. Transitioning these methods to async relates to improving their functionality for I/O operations.
